title: How I Create Viral 3D Animations in Blender
description:
In this video, I’ve put together some key tips for creating viral 3D animations in Blender.  From fluid simulations to post-processing glitches, I'll show you how I handle the 3D workflow.

I use Blender 4.5LTS.
Render EEVEE

PC Specs:
CPU: Intel Core i7-14700KF
GPU: NVIDIA GeForce RTX 4070 SUPER
RAM: 80GB
OS: Windows 11

A high-performance setup is essential for smooth fluid simulations and fast rendering. This rig allows me to push the boundaries of Blender's physics engine.
If you’re on a tight budget, I highly recommend prioritizing your GPU above all else.RAM is the easiest component to upgrade later, and for many tasks in Blender, the CPU isn’t as heavily utilized as the graphics card.

But above all, the most important thing is your originality. If you create something that stands out from the rest, even just a little, YouTube will take you to a whole new world. Let’s keep pushing forward together!
